note:
R90 - gen7 crowd team-chant banks: which key selects them? Measured on the 11 loose trees (X360 NHL 10-Legacy, PS3 NHL 11 / 14 / 15 /
Legacy) with the R89 bank-tree reader, the loader table (R85 JSON) and the committed anchors. Read-only.

Per tree:
  banks     every `<id:03>_chant.abk` (team chant, loader type AemsCrowdTeamChantBank) and `<id:04>_chant.abk` (goalie chant): record
            count, the bank's named nodes, and the names that are SPECIFIC to the bank (present in < 10 % of the tree's chant banks);
  clubs     the club-named banks (`<club>SamplePicker_msg/_snd` inside the bank): id -> club token; stability across trees;
  script    `audio/sfx/aemscrwd.csi` (MOIR crowd module): SHA-256, the `*SamplePicker_msg` names it carries, the club tokens among them.
Per anchor (the title's own main DB):
  arena     `exhibitionarena.chantaudioid` value census; for each value: bank present on the tree (loose member) / listed in the
            loader table; tenant teams (`exhibitionteams.arenaid` == arena index, NHL 13+ / Legacy; absent on 10-12) with league;
  teams     SHL (league 2) rows: index, name, audioid, arenaid -> chantaudioid; whether ANY integer field of exhibitionteams /
            exhibitionarena equals the club bank id on the club's row (the DB-key test);
  match     club token vs team name: which club banks have a team of that name on the title, and what that team's arena chant id is.
Usage: python r90_team_chant_binding.py <out.json>
